name: MMAG
recent: MMAG 近期完成出售一架 Boeing B737-400SF 飞机，交易金额为 280 万美元；同时股东在特别股东大会上通过了最多 1.3 亿令吉的资本削减议案。公司银行账户此前被反洗钱法令冻结，现已解冻。此外，法院正在审理有关公司涉嫌撤换 M Jets 董事的指控。
notable: 间接子公司 MJets Air 以 280 万美元出售一架 Boeing B737-400SF 飞机给 Mont Gabanon Airlines。
股东在特别股东大会通过最多 1.3 亿令吉的资本削减议案。
公司银行账户已从反洗钱法令限制中解冻。
risks: 法院审理有关公司涉嫌策划撤换 M Jets 董事的指控。
公司面临前高管在法庭上作证的相关法律程序。
earnings: 最近一季（2026年6月30日止）营收为 1.661 亿令吉，环比增长 0.1%，但同比下滑 26.6%；净亏损 942 万令吉，净利率为 -5.7%，较上一季的 -67.4% 有所收窄。

recent_en: MMAG recently completed the disposal of a Boeing B737-400SF aircraft for USD2.8 million, and shareholders approved a capital reduction of up to RM130 million at an EGM. The company's bank accounts, previously frozen under anti-money laundering laws, have been released. Meanwhile, a court is hearing allegations that the company plotted to oust M Jets directors.
notable_en: Indirect subsidiary MJets Air disposed of a Boeing B737-400SF aircraft to Mont Gabanon Airlines for USD2.8 million.
Shareholders passed a capital reduction of up to RM130 million at an EGM.
The company's bank accounts have been released from anti-money laundering restrictions.
risks_en: A court is hearing allegations that the company plotted to oust M Jets directors.
The company is involved in legal proceedings with a former executive director testifying in court.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM166.1 million, up 0.1% QoQ but down 26.6% YoY; net loss was RM9.42 million with a net margin of -5.7%, narrowing from -67.4% in the previous quarter.
